title: Owner decides on the model-pack cases that F-120-T02's runner entries made pending
goal: The owner says whether the agent reruns cad-3d/*, coding/* and embedded/* on gemma4:12b, or whether NERV first stops system-runner changes from invalidating model packs
acceptance: Cause: F-120-T02 adds seven system runners to evals/gauntlet/runners.json; releaseSourceKey (tools/gauntlet.mjs) hashes the whole registry, so every model-runner case recorded with a source key shows source-changed: cad-3d/* (4), coding/* (4) and embedded/* (4) in npm run check:gauntlet-runs

The owner chooses, recorded with its date in docs/work/records/F-120.md: (a) the agent reruns those 12 cases once on gemma4:12b on the Mac (a model campaign), or (b) a new step first makes releaseSourceKey hash only the runners model packs use (that changes the key once, so the same cases still need one rerun, but later system cases no longer invalidate them), or (c) not now, with a reason
Until then this step names cad-3d/*, coding/* and embedded/* so check:gauntlet-runs passes
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: Only the owner approves a real-model run

effort.basis: Opened 2026-11-26 in the F-120-T02 takeover: the runner entries made 12 model-pack cases source-changed. Not a measurement.
